case.pattern_description: The transaction was made online using a new device profile for the customer card, matching a card-not-present fraud scenario.
case.summary: Case HHG-016 is confirmed as fraud with a 95% probability and an exposure of $59.67, driven by a card-not-present transaction on a new device. Although a shared device fingerprint was dismissed as generic, the customer proactively reported the charge as unauthorized. Consequently, the card was blocked based on the customer's direct denial of the purchase.

evidence.claim: Card ID resolved from case hint
Checked for similar past closed cases (0 found)
Device profile found for flagged transaction
Device profile shared by 322 cards — treated as a generic OS/browser/screen fingerprint, not a ring signal
Case written to graph as CASE-HHG-016

case.stop_reason: Customer's own unsolicited fraud report is decisive (Section 6).

sar.reason: No FILE_REPORT criteria met: exposure $59.67 does not exceed the $1,000 R2 threshold; no shared-device link was found (R6); pattern was not classified as undocumented (R9).

next_best_actions.what_changed: Customer directly reported this transaction as unauthorized at intake (model-assessed probability was 0.95); the customer's own report takes precedence, and the case was confirmed as fraud.
